scripts.dev: bun run --cwd apps/api build && bun --bun run concurrently -k -n api,web "bun run --cwd apps/api dev" "bun run --cwd apps/web dev"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/api build && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.check: bun run --cwd apps/api check && bun run --cwd apps/web check
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run test && bun scripts/smoke-ui.mjs
